_scenario.title: Property Sales Manager
_scenario.persona: Sells apartments in Dhaka: an NRB buyer ready to pay, a family site visit, a bank loan deadline and an angry existing buyer.

all_tasks.task_details: Site visit at Skyline Gulshan duplex D2 with Mr. Shafiqul and his wife - show rooftop, generator backup and parking
Walk Imtiaz through the commercial floor proposal (2 floors, 8,000 sqft)
Send the allotment letter and developer NOC to the couple's bank loan officer
Video walkthrough of Skyline Orchid apartment B4 over WhatsApp
Send the revised commercial proposal with fit-out allowance and rent-free period
Possession date update call - he wants it in writing
Loan agreement signing at our office with Tahmina and Rashed
General check-in about the Uttara project

all_followups.followup_details: Send the payment schedule PDF and the bank details for the booking money
Re-engage with the festive price offer on Uttara 3-bed units
Confirm whether a second parking slot is available for B7, and the price
Send the signed handover timeline and booking form after the site visit
Share this month's construction progress photos of tower A

all_notes.content: Ready to pay the booking money (BDT 10 lakh) this week, needs the payment schedule in writing first. Comparing with another Bashundhara developer that offered 3% off for full upfront. Lives in Toronto: only call after 8pm Dhaka time. Prefers WhatsApp.

Wife (Mrs. Rumana) is the real decision maker - cares about the school nearby and the handover date. Budget up to BDT 6.5 crore. Got burned by a 2-year handover delay with another developer, so trust is the whole sale.
Possession of Orchid A2 was promised for August, now December. Paying rent and EMI at the same time. Already posted once in a Facebook buyers group. Wants a written date and rent support.
Wants 2 floors (8,000 sqft) for their head office from January - biggest commercial deal this quarter. Board decides on 17 Oct. Competing with a new tower in Banani that offers 3 months rent-free.
Loved the Uttara 3-bed but it was 15% above budget. The new festive offer brings it within her range. No contact for a month.

all_calls.transcript: Nusrat: Shafiqul bhai, just confirming Wednesday 11am for the duplex visit. Shafiqul: Yes, Rumana will come too. She wants to see the rooftop and check the generator backup. Nusrat: Of course, I'll arrange both. Shafiqul: Honestly the price is fine. Our worry is the handover. Last time we waited two years for a flat in Mirpur. Nusrat: I understand. I'll bring the handover timeline signed by our project director so you have it in writing. Shafiqul: That would help a lot. If the handover is guaranteed by June we can book this month. Also, is the school on Road 90 really within walking distance? Nusrat: About seven minutes on foot, I'll show you the route on the day.

Ayesha: Hi Nusrat, sorry it's late for you. I've decided on B4, I'm ready to send the booking money. Nusrat: That's wonderful news. Ayesha: But my bank here needs the payment schedule in writing and your company's bank details before they'll process an international transfer. Nusrat: I'll send you the payment schedule tonight on WhatsApp. Ayesha: Great. Also, the other developer in Bashundhara is offering 3% off if I pay in full upfront. Can you match something like that? Nusrat: Let me ask my director and come back to you. Ayesha: And can we do a video walkthrough Wednesday evening your time? My brother will visit the site on Friday. Nusrat: Yes, 6:30pm my time works, that's morning for you.

Mizanur: This is the third time I'm calling. August became October, now you say December. I'm paying rent and my home loan EMI together. Nusrat: I'm truly sorry, Mizanur bhai. The delay is on the lift installation. Mizanur: Every month it's a new reason. I want a written possession date signed by someone senior. If I don't get it by this week I'll go to RAJUK and post everything publicly. Nusrat: I'll get you a written possession date from our project director, and I'll send this month's construction photos of tower A. Mizanur: And what about compensation? I'm losing thirty thousand a month on rent. Nusrat: I'll raise rent support with management today and call you back tomorrow afternoon. Mizanur: Tomorrow. Not next week.

Imtiaz: We like your location, our staff live mostly in Gulshan and Badda. But the Banani tower is offering three months rent-free and a fit-out allowance. Nusrat: We can be competitive. What does your board need to see? Imtiaz: A revised proposal with a fit-out allowance, the rent-free period and car parking for twelve. The board meets on the 17th. Nusrat: I'll send the revised proposal by Monday. Imtiaz: Monday is fine, then I can put it in the board pack. Can you also confirm the backup power capacity per floor? Our server room needs it. Nusrat: I'll include the generator specs.

Tahmina: Apa, our bank says they need the allotment letter and the developer's NOC by Thursday, otherwise the loan disbursement slips to next month. Nusrat: Understood. I'll email both to your loan officer by Wednesday. Tahmina: Please copy me. If it slips we lose the rate we were offered. Nusrat: Will do, I'll copy you and Rashed bhai.

all_messages.content: Good morning! Still waiting for the payment schedule. My bank needs it to process the transfer today, Canada time. Please send asap 🙏

all_messages.subject: Final reminder - possession date
all_messages.content: If I do not receive the written possession date and the construction photos by Thursday, I will escalate to RAJUK and share my experience publicly with the buyers group.

all_messages.subject: Board pack
all_messages.content: Nusrat, our board pack closes Thursday. Without your revised proposal we will only present the Banani option. Please send it today if possible.
Hi, Shafiqul bhai gave me your number. Looking for a 4-bed in Gulshan or Baridhara under 4 crore. When can we talk?
Is a second parking slot available for B7? Just need a yes/no and the price.

all_messages.subject: Allotment letter and NOC
all_messages.content: Dear Tahmina, as discussed I will send the allotment letter and NOC to your loan officer by Wednesday, with you and Rashed in copy.

all_messages.subject: Festive offer on Uttara 3-bed
all_messages.content: Hi Farzana, our festive offer brings the Uttara 3-bed units down by 12%. Would you like to visit again this month?
See you tomorrow at 11. Rumana will join, please have the handover timeline ready.
